_comment: Selection manifest: each scene names a curated Dolly Parton clip by asset_id plus the duration_seconds window to use. It is NOT a PREPARE payload — resolve-pre-payload.sh reads the drive_file_id / content_sha256 / duration_ms from the media SSOT and builds the resolved scenes[].clip{} block, and run-flow.sh does it automatically before submitting. Hashes, Drive IDs, durations and availability are never trusted from this file, and this _comment is stripped before the request is sent (the master's decoder rejects unknown fields).
